title: Wasm Deployment
objective: Provide a fail-closed Cloudflare Pages preview and production deployment path for the receipt-authenticated Sage.js live app, with static contract tests and exact external activation documentation

handoff.summary: Added a fail-closed, receipt-authenticated Cloudflare Pages workflow for protected preview and production deployments, registered static workflow contract tests, and documented the dedicated-origin threat model and one-time activation procedure. Focused tests, YAML parsing, formatting, and a clean 48-file portable run passed.
risks: Cloudflare credentials and DNS authority were unavailable; app.sagejs.org did not resolve on 2026-08-20, so no remote deployment is claimed.

A later broad test:changed invocation was interrupted during pnpm build at the coordinator's request to avoid competing with the production reactor build; this temporarily invalidated ignored generated compiler output in only this worktree after the clean portable pass.
next_steps: Configure the protected GitHub environments, Cloudflare project and custom domain, then run one preview and one production deployment from a successful WebAssembly release run.
Preserve both new manifest entries when integrating concurrent test/node-test-manifest.cjs changes.
